sequence: settled frame, 1.2 s idle, then the first windowed 1:1 frame (0.505x0.505)
interpretation: The first 1:1 frame on a photo is dominated by the full-resolution RAW decode and upload (118 ms), not by the graph. Warming the canonical base once per source while the canvas is idle removes it: 182 -> 82 ms. Steady state is about 30 ms and is unchanged. The warm-up occupies the single native worker for about one decode, so it is scoped to the turbo profile and waits 750 ms of idle.
